asks: Did somebody just come down? I felt somebody come down.
description: Four steps stand here, immaculately built in pale wood with a brass rail, arriving at the height they started from.
emotes: {it} creaks under a weight that isn't on it.
The brass rail on {it} takes a highlight from a light that isn't in the room.
looks: Up, and back to here. Beautiful work.
The treads are worn where nobody could have walked.
You climb them and are exactly where you were and delighted.
name: a short flight of stairs to nowhere
